scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands one cell from a colonist crouched behind a sandbag line. The colonist sails about three cells away from the impact, clean over the sandbags, and lands on the grass alive, dazed for a moment.
scenarios.expect: accept: a shell beside a colonist throws them about three cells over sandbags, alive and briefly stunned

scenarios.text: A grenade throws a raider toward a cell another raider steps into mid-flight. Halfway through the air the thrown raider swerves and lands on a different, empty cell off to the side.
scenarios.expect: reject: a thrown pawn goes to the cell chosen at the blast and is never re-targeted

scenarios.text: A frag grenade throws a colonist into the stone wall of the kitchen. She hits the wall, bounces back two cells into the room and slides to a stop.
scenarios.expect: reject: a thrown person stops dead at a wall and takes an impact hit; people never rebound

scenarios.text: A modder's rocket has its projectile throw set to zero, while its bomb damage type throws normally. The rocket explodes beside two raiders and neither of them moves.
scenarios.expect: accept: the projectile's tuning wins over the damage type, and zero turns the throw off

scenarios.text: A launcher whose own tuning caps its throw at two cells fires into a group of pirates. One pirate standing right beside the impact is thrown five cells across the yard.
scenarios.expect: reject: a weapon's own maximum caps its throw

scenarios.text: A weapon tuned with an impact factor of 0 throws a raider into a closed wooden door. The raider stops before the door unhurt, and the door shows no damage.
scenarios.expect: accept: an impact factor of 0 makes throws hit doors harmlessly, the door undamaged

scenarios.text: A grav-ram, whose own body-size limit is 3.6, strikes beside a large pack animal of body size 3. The animal is thrown along the blast, even though an ordinary grenade would leave it standing.
scenarios.expect: accept: a weapon's own body-size limit lets it throw pawns under that limit instead of the 2.5 default

scenarios.text: With Mod Settings at their defaults, an ordinary frag grenade goes off right under a thrumbo. The thrumbo is hurled several cells across the field.
scenarios.expect: reject: pawns of body size 2.5 or more (the default) are never thrown

scenarios.text: A grenade lands in a workshop beside a finished stone sculpture weighing well over 75 kg. The sculpture flies off the floor and spins into the corner.
scenarios.expect: reject: goods heavier than the 75 kg mass limit are never thrown

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands beside a dead megasloth lying in the field. The huge corpse is flung four cells and tumbles to a stop.
scenarios.expect: reject: a corpse of body size 2.5 or more is never thrown

scenarios.text: A grenade kills a raider standing in a narrow corridor. His corpse flies off in a high spinning arc, strikes the corridor wall, bounces back a little slower and settles.
scenarios.expect: accept: a pawn the blast kills flies among the goods, high arc, spin, rebounds keeping about 70 percent

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands behind a raider standing at the edge of an open pit. The raider is thrown toward the pit and drops to its floor.
scenarios.expect: accept: anything thrown toward an open pit falls to its floor

scenarios.text: A grenade throws a pirate toward a wide open pit between him and the colony wall. He flies over the pit and lands on the far rim, unhurt.
scenarios.expect: reject: nothing is thrown across a pit; it falls to the floor

scenarios.text: A colonist carrying steel to the stockpile takes the shortest route, which crosses an open pit. She walks straight onto the pit cell and drops onto its floor.
scenarios.expect: reject: no colonist walks into a pit by ordinary pathing

scenarios.text: A raider steps onto a covered pit trap and a grenade lands on the cell next to it, not on the cover, within its radius. The cover breaks and the raider falls in.
scenarios.expect: accept: a damaging blast reaching a covered pit, on it or beside it within its radius, breaks the cover and whoever is on it falls

scenarios.text: A smoke grenade lands right on a covered pit trap with a raider standing on it. The cover shatters and the raider drops into the pit.
scenarios.expect: reject: an EMP, smoke or stun burst never breaks a pit cover

scenarios.text: A raider with a shield belt stands in a drifting flammable gas cloud when a spark lights it. The burst next to him shoves him one cell, his belt doing nothing to stop it, and he takes no harm.
scenarios.expect: accept: a gas clump shoves a pawn one cell unhurt and a shield belt does not stop the shove

scenarios.text: A flammable gas cloud filling a storeroom catches. The whole cloud goes off at once as one big blast at its middle, burning the colonists inside and throwing them three cells.
scenarios.expect: reject: a lit gas cloud goes off clump by clump, shoving people one cell unhurt, never one centroid blast

scenarios.text: A sniper's bullet hits a raider in the chest. The raider is knocked backwards two cells and lies stunned.
scenarios.expect: reject: only explosions throw; bullets move nobody

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands in a storeroom beside a wooden crate full of medicine. The crate slides one cell across the floor and its medicine stays inside.
scenarios.expect: accept: closed containers keep their goods and may be shoved one cell

scenarios.text: A grenade goes off beside a fridge packed with meals. The fridge's meals burst out and scatter across the room.
scenarios.expect: reject: closed containers keep their goods

scenarios.text: A mortar shell hits a storeroom with goods on the floor and on open shelves. The floor goods fly everywhere, but every stack on the shelves sits untouched.
scenarios.expect: reject: open shelves protect nothing; their goods scatter like floor goods

scenarios.text: The player lowers the mass limit in Mod Settings to 20 kg. The next grenade into the stockpile throws the light stacks of cloth and herbal medicine but leaves a 30 kg stack where it was, and still throws the colonist standing beside it.
scenarios.expect: accept: every Mod Settings line takes effect, the mass limit among them, with the rest still working

scenarios.text: An incendiary shell from another mod lands among a pirate squad. Fire spreads over the ground, but not one pirate is moved.
scenarios.expect: reject: every harmful explosion throws, fire at half strength, other mods too

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands in the middle of a crowded stockpile of about sixty light stacks. The stacks nearest the impact fly off spinning and bounce around the room. A row of cloth and steel stacks a few cells out, still well inside the blast and each due to be pushed a couple of cells, sits exactly where it was.
scenarios.expect: reject: every light good reached with a throw of a cell or more must move; nothing is skipped over a cap

scenarios.text: A grenade goes off in a workshop full of components and silver. Most stacks arc away spinning, but one stack of silver blinks out of its cell and is simply there on a cell four tiles away, a puff of dust marking the spot.
scenarios.expect: reject: goods never vanish and reappear under a dust puff; every good must fly

scenarios.text: A frag grenade lands in a storeroom beside an open shelf holding six stacks of medicine and meals. The floor goods scatter across the room. Two stacks from the shelf tumble off, while the other four stay on the shelf, apparently sheltered by it.
scenarios.expect: reject: open shelves protect nothing; their goods scatter like floor goods

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands beside a wooden crate of medicine. The crate slides one cell across the floor, and as it settles a couple of packets of medicine spill from it onto the floor beside it, the rest staying inside.
scenarios.expect: reject: a closed container keeps its goods; only the container itself may be shoved

scenarios.text: A grenade throws a raider into the stone wall of a corridor. He stops at the cell before the wall and takes a hit, then eases back a half step into the corridor before he settles, stunned.
scenarios.expect: reject: a thrown person stops dead at a wall and never rebounds, even slightly

scenarios.text: A raider is standing beside a closed pit trap when a burning gas cloud goes off near him. The burst shoves him one cell onto the cover, which gives way under him, and he drops into the pit.
scenarios.expect: reject: a gas burst never breaks a cover; a pawn it shoves onto a cover stands on it, the cover whole

scenarios.text: A grenade throws a heavy stack of steel toward a pit trap whose cover is still in place. The stack lands on the covered cell and rests there on top of the cover, which stays whole.
scenarios.expect: reject: a thing thrown onto a covered cell falls through and breaks the cover

scenarios.text: A colonist is caught in a long flammable gas cloud that catches fire. The bursts run through the cloud clump by clump; she is shoved one cell unhurt, and the very next clump half a second later shoves her another cell, then another.
scenarios.expect: reject: a person is shoved at most once every 2 seconds by the gas

scenarios.text: A grenade goes off in a stockpile. Near stacks fly off spinning, but a stack of wood at the very rim of the blast, which would have been pushed less than a cell, does not move at all.
scenarios.expect: accept: a thing at the rim whose throw is under one cell is spared

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands beside a locker standing against a wall, the wall directly behind it. The locker does not slide but jolts in place, and everything inside stays inside.
scenarios.expect: accept: a closed container may slide one cell or jolt; never into a wall, and its goods stay in

scenarios.text: The Cauldron has been venting its gas into a cramped workshop with steel and herbal medicine lying on the floor. A burning torch on the wall sets the edge of the cloud alight. Small bursts walk across the room one after another as the flames move through, each one flinging the nearby stacks, and the smith at the bench is pushed one cell sideways without a scratch.
scenarios.expect: accept: the Cauldron's gas, touched by fire, goes off clump by clump, scattering goods and shoving a person one cell unhurt

scenarios.text: The Cauldron's gas pools in a corner of the storeroom. A campfire burns four cells away, never reaching the cloud. A few seconds later the cloud starts bursting anyway, scattering the stacks around it.
scenarios.expect: reject: a gas cloud catches only from a fire touching it; a fire a few cells away lights nothing

scenarios.text: A fire spreads into the Cauldron's gas cloud in the brewing hall. The cloud flares up and burns as ordinary flames over the floor; nothing bursts, and the bottles and cloth beside it stay exactly where they lay.
scenarios.expect: reject: the Cauldron's gas must go off clump by clump, not burn as plain fire with no bursts

scenarios.text: One of our machines puts out a drift of tox gas across the yard, and a burning wall lamp touches the edge of it. The gas just hangs there poisoning anyone who stays; no bursts go off and the goods in it do not move.
scenarios.expect: accept: tox gas our code adds is vanilla gas that does not burn; only gas the census tags as flammable goes off

scenarios.text: A building of ours sends vanilla smoke over the stockpile, and a grass fire runs into the smoke. Bursts go off through the smoke one after another, throwing the stacks around and pushing a hauler one cell.
scenarios.expect: reject: vanilla smoke our code adds does not burn; only gas the census tags as flammable goes off clump by clump

scenarios.text: A grenade goes off in a hallway full of loose components. The stacks fly up in a high spinning arc, clear a line of sandbags, hit the closed door at the end, bounce back slower, glance off the side wall slower again, and roll to a stop.
scenarios.expect: accept: goods arc, spin, pass over sandbags and rebound off walls and closed doors losing about 30 percent each time until spent

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands in a storeroom. A stack of cloth flies up spinning in a high arc toward the closed wooden door, strikes it and drops straight down on the cell in front of it, where it stays.
scenarios.expect: reject: goods rebound off closed doors keeping about 70 percent of their speed; stopping at the first door is the wall-stop rule for people, not goods

scenarios.text: A grenade explodes on a riverbank beside a pile of silver. Part of the pile spins out over the deep water, splashes in and is gone; the player cannot find it anywhere afterwards.
scenarios.expect: reject: goods stop short of deep water and are never lost or hidden in it

scenarios.text: A frag grenade blows a stack of medicine into a small stone room. It arcs up spinning and bounces between the walls, ricocheting off each one as fast as it hit it, back and forth half a dozen times before it finally drops.
scenarios.expect: reject: each rebound keeps only about 70 percent of the speed, so the good slows at every wall rather than bouncing undiminished

scenarios.text: A frag grenade throws a colonist across the kitchen toward its stone wall. She stops on the cell right before the wall, takes a hit from the impact, and lies there stunned on that same cell.
scenarios.expect: accept: a thrown person stops dead at a wall with an impact hit and never rebounds

scenarios.text: A grenade throws a raider across the yard. While he is still in the air, a second grenade goes off right under his flight path. He carries on along his first arc to the cell he was aimed at and lands there.
scenarios.expect: accept: a pawn already airborne is never thrown again; the flight keeps the cell chosen at the first blast

scenarios.text: A frag grenade hurls a colonist toward the barracks. Mid-flight a mortar shell lands beside her and she jerks sideways in the air, flying off three more cells in a new direction before landing.
scenarios.expect: reject: a pawn already airborne is never thrown by another blast

scenarios.text: A grenade lands in the dining room beside a table set with simple meals. The meals fly off the table in spinning arcs and scatter across the floor, leaving the table bare.
scenarios.expect: accept: goods on an open table scatter like floor goods and the table is emptied

scenarios.text: A mortar shell hits a workshop. Components lying on the floor fly in every direction, but the stacks of steel and medicine on the small shelf by the door stay exactly where they were.
scenarios.expect: reject: a small shelf is open storage and protects nothing; its goods must scatter like floor goods

scenarios.text: A grenade goes off beside a wooden crate of silver standing at the lip of an open pit. The crate slides one cell straight over the edge and drops to the pit floor with its silver.
scenarios.expect: reject: a closed container may shift a cell or jolt but is never shoved into a pit

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands beside a hopper full of rice, with a colonist standing on the cell right behind it. The hopper does not move off its cell but shudders in place, and every bit of rice stays inside.
scenarios.expect: accept: with the cell behind taken by a pawn a 1x1 closed container jolts in place, contents kept

scenarios.text: The player switches off the fire-at-half part in Mod Settings and reloads the colony. An incendiary shell lands among a pirate squad; the fire spreads and each pirate is pushed a cell or so away from the impact.
scenarios.expect: reject: with fire at half switched off, fire and incendiary blasts throw nothing, as shipped today

scenarios.text: A colonist is dragging a hose end across the yard when a grenade throws him four cells. The hose end lies on the cell where he was standing, and he lands empty-handed.
scenarios.expect: accept: a thrown carrier drops the hose end on the cell they were thrown from

control.note: tree without closed_container_holds (its root id and mentions in settings_scale_and_switch and the walk) and sheet with every closed-container line stripped; the control reader got ['e20', 'e21', 'c10', 'y6'] wrong of the scenarios ['e20', 'e21', 'c4', 'c10', 'y5', 'y6'] sourced on that leaf (48 of 52 overall). Exam8 on the sheet and tree reworked against the eighth coverage judge (real defs for closed and open storage, the airborne lane on the vanilla state, fire at half off giving back the shipped no-throw, hose and gas controls aligned). Scenarios: the 44 frozen from exam7 plus 8 new (y1..y8) by a fresh examiner on the changed leaves
